sentences.en: This Sunday, February 9, is not a holiday in the United States, but it might seem like one to Americans.
sentences.zh: 这个周日，2月9日，在美国并不是法定假日，但对美国人来说，却可能像是个节日。

sentences.en: Many will be attending parties to watch Super Bowl LIX.
sentences.zh: 许多人将会参加派对，观看第59届超级碗比赛。

sentences.en: The Super Bowl is the championship game of professional American football.
sentences.zh: 超级碗是职业美式橄榄球的冠军决赛。

sentences.en: The National Football League, or NFL, has 32 teams mainly based in large cities across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国国家橄榄球联盟，简称NFL，共有32支球队，主要分布在美国各大城市。

sentences.en: The first professional league was formed in 1920, when representatives of four teams met in Canton, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 第一个职业联盟成立于1920年，当时四支球队的代表在俄亥俄州的坎顿聚集。

sentences.en: The group first called itself the American Professional Football Association but changed the name two years later to the National Football League.
sentences.zh: 这个组织最初自称美国职业橄榄球联盟，两年后将名称改为国家橄榄球联盟。

sentences.en: In 1960, Texas businessman Lamar Hunt pushed the effort to create the American Football League, or AFL.
sentences.zh: 1960年，得州商人拉马尔·亨特推动了美国橄榄球联盟，即AFL的创建。

sentences.en: The two leagues competed with each other to sign top football players from universities around the country.
sentences.zh: 这两个联盟竞相签约来自全国各地大学的顶尖橄榄球运动员。

sentences.en: In 1965, established NFL players began negotiating to play for the competing league.
sentences.zh: 1965年，已成名的NFL球员开始谈判，要求为那个竞争联盟效力。

sentences.en: So, officials of the two leagues decided to work together.
sentences.zh: 于是，两个联盟的官员决定合作。

sentences.en: This agreement established a championship game between the two leagues.
sentences.zh: 这项协议确立了两联盟之间的冠军赛。

sentences.en: It was officially called the AFL-NFL World Championship Game but became known as the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 它正式的名称是美国橄榄球联盟对国家橄榄球联盟世界冠军赛，但后来被称为超级碗。

sentences.en: The first Super Bowl was played in 1967 in Los Angeles, California.
sentences.zh: 第一届超级碗于1967年加利福尼亚州的洛杉矶举行。

sentences.en: The Green Bay Packers defeated the Kansas City Chiefs.
sentences.zh: 绿湾包装工队击败了堪萨斯城酋长队。

sentences.en: It was not a very exciting game.
sentences.zh: 那场比赛并不十分精彩。

sentences.en: Many of the seats in the sports center were empty.
sentences.zh: 体育中心里的许多座位都是空着的。

sentences.en: That changed with the Super Bowl played two years later.
sentences.zh: 两年后的那届超级碗改变了这一状况。

sentences.en: Experts say the public finally accepted the new league when the New York Jets defeated the Baltimore Colts.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，当纽约喷气机队击败巴尔的摩小马队时，公众终于接受了这个新联盟。

sentences.en: After that game in 1969, officials of the two leagues decided to create a new National Football League.
sentences.zh: 在1969年的那场比赛之后，两个联盟的官员决定组建一个新的国家橄榄球联盟。

sentences.en: They divided the teams into two competing conferences, the American Conference, or AFC, and the National Conference, NFC.
sentences.zh: 他们把球队分成两个竞争的联合会，即美国联合会，简称AFC，和国家联合会，简称NFC。

sentences.en: Each year, the conference champions play in the Super Bowl.
sentences.zh: 每年，各赛区的冠军球队都会参加超级碗比赛。

sentences.en: Today, the Super Bowl is a major sporting event.
sentences.zh: 如今，超级碗已成为一项重大的体育赛事。

sentences.en: Tens of thousands of people will be watching the game Sunday at the Superdome in New Orleans, Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 周日，数万人将在路易斯安那州新奥尔良的超级穹顶体育场观看比赛。

sentences.en: Tens of millions of other people around the world will be watching Super Bowl LIX.
sentences.zh: 全球还有数千万人将观看第九十届超级碗。

sentences.en: They will be watching to see if the AFC Kansas City Chiefs or the NFC Philadelphia Eagles become the champions of American football.
sentences.zh: 他们观赛是想看看美国橄榄球联盟（AFC）的堪萨斯城酋长队还是国家橄榄球联盟（NFC）的费城老鹰队成为美国橄榄球冠军。

sentences.en: Both teams have had success in the Big Game.
sentences.zh: 这两支球队都在这场大赛中取得过成功。

sentences.en: The Eagles are one-time NFL champions.
sentences.zh: 老鹰队曾获得过一次NFL冠军。

sentences.en: They defeated the New England Patriots in Super Bowl LII.
sentences.zh: 他们在第二十五届超级碗比赛中击败了新英格兰爱国者队。

sentences.en: This Sunday will be the team’s fifth NFL championship game appearance.
sentences.zh: 这个周日将是该队第五次参加NFL冠军赛。

sentences.en: The Kansas City Chiefs have played for the championship six times.
sentences.zh: 堪萨斯城酋长队已六次参加冠军赛。

sentences.en: They have won four times, including the last two Super Bowls.
sentences.zh: 他们四次夺冠，包括最近两届超级碗。

sentences.en: The Chiefs are the first team in NFL history to have a chance to win a third Super Bowl in a row.
sentences.zh: 酋长队是NFL历史上第一支有望连续第三次赢得超级碗的球队。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver.
sentences.zh: 我是凯蒂·韦弗。

glossary.def: sports teams that play each other and are linked by a business agreement and rules

glossary.zh: 令人兴奋的；激动人心的
